entries.title: Check machine assignments and service needs at a glance
entries.description: The Machines table now shows the current job, customer and farm, the latest reading with its date, and the next service due. Open the linked job directly from the table.

entries.title: Follow each machine’s progress on a job
entries.description: Machine stint timelines bring planned work, arrival, departure, measures and breakdowns together in time order. Use the + menu to add a measure or report a Code Green or Code Red problem.

entries.title: Report breakdowns from Jobs or Workshop
entries.description: Choose the machine or implement, set the urgency and attach photos directly from either screen. Check the Already reported list before submitting another report.

entries.title: Track repairs from report to completion
entries.description: Workshop breakdown cards now show a timeline covering Reported, Mechanic, Fixing and Fixed, making repair progress easier to follow.

entries.title: Check machine details, service needs and readings
entries.description: Machine screens now have separate Details and Readings tabs, with service information and the current job shown on dedicated cards. Load older readings as you browse the history.

entries.title: Report a problem from one place on each stint
entries.description: Use Report a problem, then choose whether the issue affects the machine or its attached implement.

entries.title: Review completed repairs
entries.description: Fixed breakdowns now show a read-only summary so you can review the completed repair.

entries.title: Scan lists more easily
entries.description: Machine, job, field note and workshop lists now use a consistent card layout.
